lines.text: The root is Mit! Dismiss, promise.
Did you know? Mit is Latin for send.
Quick quiz! Which means forward plus send?

words.ex: The teacher dismissed the class early.
I promise I'll call you tonight.

publish.title: Mit root: dismiss and promise
publish.value: Mit comes from Latin "mittere" (to send). Words: dismiss and promise. dismiss = dis + miss; promise = pro + mis.
